blur_detection.description: The receipt shows clear text with sharp edge definition and good focus throughout the document.
blur_detection.recommendation: No action needed as text clarity is sufficient for OCR processing.

contrast_assessment.description: The receipt displays excellent black text on white background with strong contrast for optimal readability.
contrast_assessment.recommendation: Maintain this level of contrast for future document captures.

glare_identification.description: Mild glare is visible in some areas of the receipt but doesn't significantly impact text readability.
glare_identification.recommendation: Consider using diffused lighting when capturing receipts to minimize reflective glare.

water_stains.description: No water stains, discoloration or water damage detected on the receipt.
water_stains.recommendation: Continue keeping receipts dry and protected from liquids.

tears_or_folds.description: Minor creases visible across the receipt but text remains fully legible and undistorted.
tears_or_folds.recommendation: Consider using a document flattening tool or scanning surface for completely crease-free captures.

cut_off_detection.description: The receipt is fully captured with all edges visible and no content cut off.
cut_off_detection.recommendation: Maintain this complete framing approach for future document captures.

missing_sections.description: The receipt appears complete with header, line items, totals, and footer information all present.
missing_sections.recommendation: No action needed as all expected receipt sections are visible.

obstructions.description: No fingers, shadows or other obstructions covering any part of the receipt content.
obstructions.recommendation: Continue using this clean capture technique for future document imaging.
